title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation plus ANN surrogate can accurately predict friction stir welding temperatures, forces, and defect formation in HDPE, enabling fast identification of robust process windows.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical welding guidance showing that bottom preheating and higher rotation/lower travel speed improve weld quality while reducing force fluctuations and wormhole defects.
method: 3D Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE FSW
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental temperature and axial-force histories
Process-map generation across rotational speed, welding speed, and bottom preheating conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R2 values of 0.91 to 0.99, and the CEL model matched experiments for void formation, thermal response, and vertical force behavior.
infographic.watch_item: The trained models are validated on the tested parameter space, so extrapolation to other polymers, tool geometries, or wider process ranges may be unreliable without retraining.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯摩擦搅拌焊焊缝质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，系统研究了高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）摩擦搅拌焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征的预测问题。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟在不同工艺参数（转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件）下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型与实验数据进行了对比验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出明显良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面60 °C预热将峰值压入力从接近1600 N降至约1100 N，并将峰值温度从70 °C（无预热）提高到约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时间响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和较强泛化能力。计算CEL仿真能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机械影响区和热影响区；而组合的CEL–ANN框架能够快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷与无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm、30 mm/min并采用60 °C预热时获得了最佳条件，而在无预热、1000 rpm条件下由于虫洞形成表现出较差的可焊性。这些研究结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了面向工艺的设计指南，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 耦合的CEL仿真与ANN代理模型可准确预测HDPE摩擦搅拌焊中的温度、力和缺陷形成，从而快速识别稳健的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了实用的焊接指导，表明底部预热以及更高转速/更低行进速度有助于提高焊缝质量，同时减少力波动和虫洞缺陷。
method: HDPE摩擦搅拌焊的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验温度和轴向力历史训练的两个多层感知器ANN
跨转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件的工艺图生成
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型的R2值达到0.91至0.99，且CEL模型在孔洞形成、热响应和竖直力行为方面与实验吻合。
infographic.watch_item: 所训练模型仅在测试参数空间内得到验证，因此若不重新训练，将其外推到其他聚合物、工具几何形状或更宽的工艺范围可能并不可靠。

title: An AI-Based Vision System for Detecting Defects in Resistance Spot Welding and Predicting Maintenance in Robotic Cells
authors: Alfonso Alejo-Ramirez, Rogelio Cedeno-Moreno, Luis A. Morales‐Hernandez, Juan Carlos Jáuregui-Correa, Irving A. Cruz-Albarran
abstract: The automotive industry is adopting the Industry 4.0 model to reduce failures in electrical resistance spot welding by using automated non-destructive testing systems. This study presents a real-time machine vision system that has been implemented on an automotive cabin assembly line to detect weld defects in door frames. The system extracts the physical parameters of each spot weld, including nugget diameter and heat-affected zone, to identify failing robots and welding points and prioritise maintenance actions (maintenance-free, predictive, preventive or corrective). Machine learning models were trained using images from 674 cabins collected over 30 continuous hours. YOLOv8 was used for spot weld detection and feature extraction. A neural network with linear discriminant analysis was applied for defect classification, achieving 95.80% accuracy, 95.61% precision, 96.00% recall and 95.80% F1-score. Additionally, a convolutional neural network was developed for maintenance prediction, achieving 94.72% precision, 95.87% accuracy, 93.97% F1-score and 94.42% recall. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of real-time defect detection and reliable maintenance prediction, supporting informed decision-making and efficient resource management.

infographic.key_insight: A real-time vision pipeline can detect resistance spot weld defects and predict maintenance needs directly on an automotive assembly line.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables earlier intervention on failing robots and weld points, improving quality control, uptime, and maintenance prioritization in robotic welding cells.
method: YOLOv8 detects spot welds and extracts physical features such as nugget diameter and heat-affected zone.
A neural network with linear discriminant analysis classifies defective welds.
A CNN predicts maintenance category: maintenance-free, predictive, preventive, or corrective.
infographic.evidence_signal: Trained on images from 674 cabins collected over 30 continuous hours, the system achieved 95.80% accuracy for defect classification and 94.72% precision for maintenance prediction.
infographic.watch_item: Performance was demonstrated on a specific automotive line, so robustness to different weld geometries, lighting conditions, and production settings still needs validation.
infographic.paper_title: An AI-Based Vision System for Detecting Defects in Resistance Spot Welding and Predicting Maintenance in Robotic Cells

zh-Hans.title: 基于人工智能的视觉系统，用于检测电阻点焊缺陷并预测机器人单元中的维护需求
zh-Hans.abstract: 汽车行业正在采用工业4.0模型，通过使用自动化无损检测系统来减少电阻点焊中的失效。本文提出了一种实时机器视觉系统，已部署于汽车车身装配线上，用于检测车门框架中的焊接缺陷。该系统提取每个点焊的物理参数，包括熔核直径和热影响区，以识别失效机器人和焊接点，并对维护措施进行优先排序（免维护、预测性、预防性或纠正性）。机器学习模型使用从674个车厢采集、连续30小时获取的图像进行训练。YOLOv8用于点焊检测和特征提取。采用带线性判别分析的神经网络进行缺陷分类，准确率达到95.80%，精确率95.61%，召回率96.00%，F1分数95.80%。此外，还开发了一个卷积神经网络用于维护预测，精确率达到94.72%，准确率95.87%，F1分数93.97%，召回率94.42%。结果表明，实时缺陷检测和可靠的维护预测具有良好效果，可支持有依据的决策和高效的资源管理。

infographic.key_insight: 实时视觉处理流程可以直接在汽车装配线上检测电阻点焊缺陷并预测维护需求。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这有助于更早干预失效机器人和焊点，提高机器人焊接单元中的质量控制、设备可用率和维护优先级排序。
method: YOLOv8检测点焊并提取熔核直径和热影响区等物理特征。
带线性判别分析的神经网络对缺陷焊缝进行分类。
CNN预测维护类别：免维护、预测性、预防性或纠正性。
infographic.evidence_signal: 系统使用从674个车厢中采集、连续30小时获取的图像进行训练，在缺陷分类中达到95.80%的准确率，在维护预测中达到94.72%的精确率。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能结果是在特定汽车产线上验证的，因此对不同焊点几何形状、照明条件和生产设置的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。

title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
authors: Yue Cao, Hai Lin, YuMing Zhang
abstract: Arc welding processes are essential for continuous fabrication but prone to disturbances that impair weld quality, making real-time monitoring critical yet difficult due to complex visual patterns and nonlinear, time-varying dynamics. Deep learning shows promise but faces scalability limits because of its dependence on large labeled datasets and application-specific tuning. We explore whether a unified approach can characterize major arc welding processes across applications and improve scalability through consistent state monitoring. This paper introduces a robust and generalizable monitoring framework for arc welding. It combines unsupervised deep latent representation learning, which extracts compact features from weld pool images, with Bayesian filtering to handle persistent and fluctuating disturbances such as arc radiation and specular reflections. Specifically, a Dynamic Variational Autoencoder (DVAE), consisting of a CNN-based encoder-decoder and an LSTM-based transition model, jointly learns latent representations and their evolution under control inputs. For robust real-time inference, a specialized Particle Filter (PF) propagates the latent and LSTM hidden states, preserving process history while suppressing sensor noise. This design is well suited to welding's slow and inertial dynamics. Validation on GTAW and GMAW without process-specific tuning demonstrates the framework's generalizability and robustness.

infographic.key_insight: A unified DVAE + particle filter framework can learn and track latent weld-process states robustly across different arc welding applications.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables more scalable real-time welding monitoring by reducing reliance on large labeled datasets and process-specific tuning.
method: CNN encoder-decoder learns compact latent features from weld pool images.
LSTM transition model captures time evolution under control inputs.
Particle filter propagates latent and hidden states to suppress noise and preserve process history.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on GTAW and GMAW without process-specific tuning, indicating generalizability and robustness.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may still depend on image quality and the ability of the latent model to capture highly variable arc disturbances in new welding setups.
infographic.paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter

zh-Hans.title: 面向电弧焊过程的鲁棒监测：基于 DVAE 与粒子滤波的通用框架
zh-Hans.abstract: 电弧焊过程是连续制造中的关键工艺，但容易受到扰动影响焊缝质量，因此实时监测至关重要。然而，由于视觉模式复杂且动力学具有非线性、时变特性，实时监测也十分困难。深度学习显示出应用潜力，但由于其依赖大量标注数据且需要针对具体应用进行调参，因而面临可扩展性限制。我们探讨一种统一方法是否能够表征不同应用中的主要电弧焊过程，并通过一致的状态监测提升可扩展性。本文提出一种用于电弧焊的鲁棒且通用的监测框架。该框架将无监督深度潜在表示学习与贝叶斯滤波相结合：前者从熔池图像中提取紧凑特征，后者用于处理诸如弧光辐射和镜面反射等持续性与波动性扰动。具体而言，动态变分自编码器（DVAE）由基于 CNN 的编码器-解码器和基于 LSTM 的转移模型组成，可联合学习潜在表示及其在控制输入作用下的演化。为实现鲁棒的实时推断，专门设计的粒子滤波器（PF）传播潜在状态和 LSTM 隐状态，在抑制传感器噪声的同时保留过程历史。该设计非常适合焊接过程缓慢且具有惯性的动力学特征。对 GTAW 和 GMAW 的验证且无需针对具体工艺调参，表明该框架具有良好的通用性与鲁棒性。

infographic.key_insight: 统一的 DVAE + 粒子滤波框架能够在不同电弧焊应用中鲁棒地学习并跟踪潜在焊接过程状态。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这通过减少对大量标注数据和工艺特定调参的依赖，实现了更具可扩展性的实时焊接监测。
method: CNN 编码器-解码器从熔池图像中学习紧凑的潜在特征。
LSTM 转移模型捕获控制输入作用下的时间演化。
粒子滤波器传播潜在状态和隐状态，以抑制噪声并保留过程历史。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在无需针对具体工艺调参的情况下对 GTAW 和 GMAW 的验证，表明其通用性和鲁棒性。
infographic.watch_item: 性能仍可能取决于图像质量，以及潜在模型在新焊接设置中捕获高度变化的电弧扰动的能力。

title: TIG welding defect detection using ResNet and Random Forest
authors: Vu Quang Huy, Vu Minh Thuan, Hoang Van Huong, Tran Minh The Uyen, Van-Thuc Nguyen, Pham Son Minh
abstract: Orbital TIG welding is critical in precision manufacturing, where weld defects can affect structural reliability. Manual inspection, analysis, and evaluation of welding defect images are complex because defect characteristics vary in shape, position, and size, making the process time-consuming. This study proposes a method that combines ResNet50 feature extraction with Random Forest classification to improve classification accuracy. A total of 3,219 weld image samples collected from controlled orbital TIG experiments were used for model training and evaluation and divided into four classes: normal weld, lack of fusion, overheating, and uneven weld. Using five-fold cross-validation, the method achieved an overall accuracy of 98% and demonstrated improved performance compared with CNN architectures (VGG16, VGG19, ResNet18, ResNet50) and traditional machine learning approaches such as SVM and Random Forest. ResNet50 extracts hierarchical visual representations through deep residual connections, enabling automatic feature learning, while Random Forest performs the final classification with robustness against overfitting on high-dimensional features.

infographic.key_insight: A ResNet50-plus-Random-Forest pipeline can classify orbital TIG weld defects with very high accuracy by combining deep visual feature extraction with a robust tree-based classifier.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a practical inspection aid for precision welding lines, helping detect defect types early and improve structural reliability with less manual analysis.
method: Extract deep features from weld images using ResNet50
Classify four weld categories with Random Forest
Validate performance with five-fold cross-validation
infographic.evidence_signal: The study used 3,219 weld images from controlled orbital TIG experiments and reported 98% overall accuracy across normal weld, lack of fusion, overheating, and uneven weld classes.
infographic.watch_item: Performance was demonstrated on controlled experimental data, so generalization to different welding setups, cameras, or lighting conditions may need further validation.
infographic.paper_title: TIG welding defect detection using ResNet and Random Forest

zh-Hans.title: 使用 ResNet 和 Random Forest 的 TIG 焊接缺陷检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 轨道 TIG 焊接在精密制造中至关重要，焊接缺陷会影响结构可靠性。由于缺陷特征在形状、位置和尺寸上各不相同，对焊接缺陷图像进行人工检查、分析和评估较为复杂，因此这一过程耗时较长。本研究提出一种将 ResNet50 特征提取与 Random Forest 分类相结合的方法，以提高分类准确率。研究使用了从受控轨道 TIG 实验中采集的 3,219 张焊缝图像样本用于模型训练和评估，并将其分为四类：正常焊缝、未熔合、过热和焊缝不均匀。采用五折交叉验证后，该方法实现了 98% 的总体准确率，并且相较于 CNN 架构（VGG16、VGG19、ResNet18、ResNet50）以及 SVM 和 Random Forest 等传统机器学习方法表现更优。ResNet50 通过深层残差连接提取分层视觉表示，实现自动特征学习；同时，Random Forest 以对高维特征上过拟合的鲁棒性完成最终分类。

infographic.key_insight: ResNet50 加 Random Forest 的流程可通过结合深度视觉特征提取与稳健的树模型分类器，以极高准确率对轨道 TIG 焊接缺陷进行分类。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为精密焊接生产线提供了一种实用的检测辅助手段，有助于尽早识别缺陷类型，并以更少的人工分析提高结构可靠性。
method: 使用 ResNet50 从焊缝图像中提取深度特征
使用 Random Forest 对四类焊缝进行分类
通过五折交叉验证验证性能
infographic.evidence_signal: 该研究使用了来自受控轨道 TIG 实验的 3,219 张焊缝图像，并在正常焊缝、未熔合、过热和焊缝不均匀四类上报告了 98% 的总体准确率。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能是在受控实验数据上验证的，因此在不同焊接设置、相机或光照条件下的泛化能力可能还需要进一步验证。

title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network
authors: Keonvin Park, Yong Ann Voeurn, Hyeokjun Kweon, Doyun Lee
abstract: Reliable seam segmentation is essential for autonomous robotic welding in construction, where harsh illumination, specular reflections, and thin weld geometries often degrade segmentation performance. This study proposes a reflection-robust seam segmentation framework that enhances a BiSeNetV2 backbone through transfer learning and a hybrid Cross-Entropy--Lovász loss. Rather than increasing architectural complexity, the proposed framework improves reflection robustness through learning-stability-oriented optimization. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 81.76\% Joint IoU and 90.73\% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by +22.36 percentage points over the OHEM-based baseline while maintaining identical FLOPs, parameter count, and inference speed. The proposed approach also recovers 96.33\% of severe zero-IoU failure cases under reflective conditions. Comparative experiments across BiSeNetV2, DeepLabV3+, UNet, and SegFormer further demonstrate that the proposed optimization strategy is particularly effective for lightweight real-time segmentation architectures. Qualitative analyses additionally show improved seam continuity and reflection robustness in challenging welding environments. These findings suggest that the proposed framework provides a practical and lightweight perception solution for robotic welding applications involving reflective metallic surfaces.

infographic.key_insight: A transfer-learning + hybrid Cross-Entropy/Lovász optimization strategy makes BiSeNetV2 much more robust to reflective weld seams without adding model complexity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a lightweight, real-time seam segmentation upgrade for construction welding robots operating under harsh lighting and specular metallic reflections.
method: Start from a BiSeNetV2 backbone and apply transfer learning to stabilize training.
Use a hybrid Cross-Entropy + Lovász loss to improve boundary-aware seam segmentation.
Keep the architecture unchanged to preserve FLOPs, parameters, and inference speed.
infographic.evidence_signal: The proposed method reached 81.76% Joint IoU and 90.73% mIoU, improving Joint IoU by 22.36 points over the OHEM baseline while recovering 96.33% of severe zero-IoU failures.
infographic.watch_item: Performance gains are reported on challenging reflective welding data, so deployment should still be validated for new site lighting, surface finishes, and seam geometries.
infographic.paper_title: Enhanced Seam Segmentation for Automated Welding Robot in Construction Through Transfer Learning: Addressing Limitations of Bilateral Segmentation Network

zh-Hans.title: 通过迁移学习增强建筑自动焊接机器人的焊缝分割：解决双边分割网络的局限性
zh-Hans.abstract: 在建筑场景中的自主机器人焊接中，可靠的焊缝分割至关重要；在此类场景下，恶劣照明、镜面反射以及细窄的焊缝几何形态常会降低分割性能。本研究提出一种抗反射焊缝分割框架，通过迁移学习和混合交叉熵--Lovász损失函数增强BiSeNetV2骨干网络。与增加网络结构复杂度不同，所提出的框架通过面向训练稳定性的优化来提升抗反射能力。实验结果表明，所提方法实现了81.76\%的Joint IoU和90.73\%的mIoU，在保持FLOPs、参数量和推理速度完全一致的同时，相较于基于OHEM的基线，Joint IoU提升了+22.36个百分点。所提方法还在反射条件下恢复了96.33\%的严重零IoU失败案例。对BiSeNetV2、DeepLabV3+、UNet和SegFormer的对比实验进一步表明，所提出的优化策略对轻量级实时分割架构尤为有效。定性分析还显示，在具有挑战性的焊接环境中，焊缝连续性和抗反射能力均有所提升。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为涉及反光金属表面的机器人焊接应用提供了一种实用且轻量级的感知解决方案。

infographic.key_insight: 迁移学习 + 混合交叉熵/Lovász优化策略使BiSeNetV2在不增加模型复杂度的情况下，对反射性焊缝具有更强的鲁棒性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为在强光和金属镜面反射条件下运行的建筑焊接机器人提供了一种轻量级、实时的焊缝分割升级方案。

title: "Anomalous Solid Solution" in Ultra-High Melting Point Oxides: A New Strategy for Developing Ultra-High Temperature Thermal Protection Coatings
authors: Yubo Wang, Hong Meng, Pengfei He, Shujun Hu, Chuan Sun, Ximing Duan
abstract: The high-temperature performance of ultra-high temperature ceramics (UHTCs) in atmospheric environment is fundamentally governed by their melting points of oxidation products. Typical high-melting-point oxides, such as ZrO2, undergo phase transformations at elevated temperatures, leading to structural instability. Although doping with rare-earth or transition-metal cations can suppress these transformations, it often results in a reduction in melting point, thereby limiting practical service temperature. Here, ytterbia-stabilized zirconia (YbSZ) coatings are prepared via atmospheric plasma spraying, achieving a remarkable increase in the melting point of ZrO2 to approximately 2850 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and raising the ultimate plasma and oxyacetylene ablation temperature up to nearly 2780 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and 3200 $^\circ\mathrm{C}$, which is the highest temperature resistance property as reported. Notably, this performance enhancement originates from a synergistic mechanism of strengthened ionic-covalent mixed bonding and improved oxygen vacancy stability. Based on these findings, the concept of "anomalous solid solution" is firstly proposed to be used in the area of ultra-high temperature protection, which provides new insights into the compositional design of UHTC systems.

infographic.engineering_relevance: This suggests a new compositional route for thermal protection coatings that can survive more extreme plasma and oxyacetylene environments without the usual melting-point penalty from stabilizing dopants.

zh-Hans.title: 超高熔点氧化物中的“异常固溶体”：一种开发超高温热防护涂层的新策略
zh-Hans.abstract: 超高温陶瓷（UHTCs）在大气环境中的高温性能，本质上受其氧化产物的熔点控制。典型的高熔点氧化物，如 ZrO2，在高温下会发生相变，导致结构不稳定。尽管通过掺杂稀土或过渡金属阳离子可以抑制这些相变，但这通常会降低熔点，从而限制实际服役温度。本文通过大气等离子喷涂制备了氧化镱稳定氧化锆（YbSZ）涂层，将 ZrO2 的熔点显著提高至约 2850 °C，并将最终的等离子和氧乙炔烧蚀温度分别提升至接近 2780 °C 和 3200 °C，这一耐温性能为迄今报道的最高水平。值得注意的是，这种性能提升源于离子-共价混合键增强与氧空位稳定性改善的协同机制。基于这些发现，首次提出“异常固溶体”概念并将其用于超高温防护领域，为 UHTC 体系的成分设计提供了新的认识。

title: Tribological enhancement of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun coated Ti-6Al-4V alloy: A machine learning approach
authors: Selwyn Jebadurai Devaraj, A. Arul Jeya Kumar, A Queen Alice, V Manoj Kumar, S Arokya Agustin, A Sarath Chandra
abstract: Ti-6Al-4V alloy is used a lot in aerospace, biomedical and marine applications. This study investigates the tribological behaviour of Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coated and uncoated Ti-6Al-4V alloy by experimental and machine learning approaches. An Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 ceramic coating, approximately 200 µm thick, was applied to Ti-6Al-4V alloy via the detonation gun (D-gun) process under regulated conditions (oxygen flow: 4800 SLPH, acetylene: 2150 SLPH, stand-off distance: 180 mm, particle velocity ∼1200 m/s). The wear behaviour of samples was tested using a pin-on-disc apparatus in accordance with ASTM G99 standards. Tests were conducted under normal loads of 40–100 N, sliding speeds of 100–200 rpm and durations of 20–40 min against an EN31 steel counter face. Scanning electron microscopy demonstrated that coated surfaces exhibited reduced wear and formed a protective tribo-layer. Machine learning models such as artificial neural networks, K-nearest neighbours and random forest were developed to predict wear based on sliding parameters. Random forest proved to be the best choice with less mean percentage error and mean squared error. The results showed that D-gun deposited Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 coatings improved the wear performance of Ti-6Al-4V.
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

zh-Hans.title: Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 D-gun 涂层 Ti-6Al-4V 合金的摩擦学增强：一种机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V 合金广泛应用于航空航天、生物医学和海洋领域。本研究通过实验和机器学习方法，研究了 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层与未涂层 Ti-6Al-4V 合金的摩擦学行为。采用受控条件下的爆炸喷涂枪（detonation gun，D-gun）工艺在 Ti-6Al-4V 合金上制备了约 200 µm 厚的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 陶瓷涂层（氧气流量：4800 SLPH，乙炔：2150 SLPH，喷距：180 mm，粒子速度约 1200 m/s）。根据 ASTM G99 标准，使用销-盘摩擦磨损试验机测试样品的磨损行为。试验在 40–100 N 的法向载荷、100–200 rpm 的滑动速度以及 20–40 min 的持续时间条件下，针对 EN31 钢对偶面进行。扫描电子显微镜结果表明，涂层表面磨损减小，并形成了保护性摩擦层。建立了人工神经网络、K 近邻和随机森林等机器学习模型，用于基于滑动参数预测磨损。随机森林表现最佳，具有更低的平均百分比误差和均方误差。结果表明，D-gun 沉积的 Al 2 O 3 -TiO 2 涂层提高了 Ti-6Al-4V 的耐磨性能。

title: Hot corrosion behavior of thermal sprayed using HVAF and DS techniques with Tribaloy-400 coatings for solar energy storage container
authors: P. Sakthivel, G. Sivakumar, M. Manikandan
abstract: The present study investigates the high-temperature corrosion behaviour of Tribaloy-400 (T-400) coatings deposited on ASTM A516 steel using two thermal spray techniques: (i) High Velocity Air Fuel (HVAF) spraying and (ii) Detonation Spraying (DS). The coated specimens were exposed to a molten solar salt environment consisting of 60% NaNO 3 –40% KNO 3 at 500 °C for exposure durations up to 1000 hours to evaluate their oxidation and corrosion resistance. Phase analysis indicated the formation of stable protective oxide phases, including Cr 2 O 3 , Co 3 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , in both coating systems. Elemental mapping revealed that the HVAF coating retained a uniform Cr–Mo–Si–O enriched surface with minimal molten salt penetration even after prolonged exposure of 1000 hours. In contrast, the DS coating exhibited comparatively deeper salt ingress into the coating microstructure, which contributed to increased degradation and spallation. SEM observations showed that the HVAF coatings possessed a dense and well-bonded microstructure, along with the formation of thermodynamically stable oxides such as Cr 2 O 3 , CoCr 2 O 4 , and CoMoO 4 , resulting in superior resistance to molten salt-induced corrosion. However, the relatively porous nature of the DS coating promoted salt-assisted oxide dissolution, leading to higher mass gain, increased spallation, and accelerated degradation during extended exposure. Comparative evaluation of both coating techniques was carried out to identify a suitable coating process and feedstock combination for high-temperature CSP applications.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: For concentrated solar power thermal storage containers, HVAF coating offers a more durable surface protection strategy than detonation spraying under long-term nitrate-salt exposure.

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVAF和DS技术制备Tribaloy-400涂层用于太阳能储能容器的热腐蚀行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用两种热喷涂技术——(i) 高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAF）和(ii) 爆炸喷涂（DS）——沉积在ASTM A516钢上的Tribaloy-400（T-400）涂层的高温腐蚀行为。将涂覆试样暴露于由60% NaNO3–40% KNO3组成的熔融太阳盐环境中，在500 °C下暴露最长达1000小时，以评估其抗氧化和耐腐蚀性能。相分析表明，两种涂层体系中均形成了稳定的保护性氧化物相，包括Cr2O3、Co3O4和CoMoO4。元素映射显示，HVAF涂层在暴露1000小时后仍保持均匀的Cr–Mo–Si–O富集表面，且熔盐渗透极少。相比之下，DS涂层表现出相对更深的盐向涂层微观结构内部侵入，这导致了更严重的退化和剥落。SEM观察表明，HVAF涂层具有致密且结合良好的微观结构，并形成了热力学稳定的氧化物，如Cr2O3、CoCr2O4和CoMoO4，从而对熔盐诱导腐蚀表现出更优异的抵抗能力。然而，DS涂层相对多孔的特性促进了盐辅助的氧化物溶解，导致更高的增重、更多的剥落以及在长时间暴露过程中的加速退化。为识别适用于高温CSP应用的合适涂层工艺与供粉组合，对两种涂层技术进行了比较评估。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于聚光太阳能热储能容器，在长期硝酸盐熔盐暴露条件下，HVAF涂层比爆炸喷涂提供更耐久的表面防护方案。

title: Integrated AHP and metallurgical approach: comparing welding techniques and characterizing NiCrBSi coatings in hardfacing
authors: Sachin P. Kakade, D. D. Deshmukh
abstract: In this study, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) was employed to select the optimal hardfacing method from shielded metal arc welding (SMAW), metal inert gas (MIG) welding, Tungsten inert gas (TIG) welding, automatic TIG welding, and plasma transferred arc welding (PTAW). PTAW was identified as the superior technique, demonstrating higher microhardness (501.8 HV<sub>1</sub>) and a composite grade of 0.47 compared to other methods. The research used a 130 mm × 100 mm × 30 mm SS410 steel substrate and Colmonoy-4 nickel-based alloy powder with a grain size of 40–60 µm. The key process parameters transferred arc current (TC), powder feed rate (PF), speed of oscillation (SO), welding speed (WS), and plasma gas flow rate (PG) were identified through literature and preliminary studies. Microstructural analysis revealed the presence of carbides and borides of nickel, chromium, and iron, including α-Cr<sub>7</sub>C<sub>3</sub>, β-(Cr, Fe)<sub>7</sub>C<sub>3</sub>, δ-Cr<sub>23</sub>C<sub>7</sub>, θ-Ni<sub>3</sub>B, ψ-CrB, μ-Cr<sub>2</sub>B, and γ-Ni, which contributed to the enhanced hardness. The findings suggest that industries can enhance component life and reduce costs related to raw materials, rework, and surface defects by adopting optimized PTAW parameters.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用层次分析法（AHP）从屏蔽金属电弧焊（SMAW）、金属惰性气体焊（MIG）、钨极惰性气体焊（TIG）、自动TIG焊以及等离子转移弧焊（PTAW）中选择最优的硬面堆焊方法。结果表明，PTAW为优选技术，其显微硬度更高（501.8 HV<sub>1</sub>），综合等级为0.47，优于其他方法。研究采用尺寸为130 mm × 100 mm × 30 mm的SS410钢基体和粒径为40–60 µm的Colmonoy-4镍基合金粉末。通过文献调研和初步研究确定了关键工艺参数：转移弧电流（TC）、送粉速率（PF）、摆动速度（SO）、焊接速度（WS）和等离子气体流量（PG）。显微组织分析显示存在镍、铬和铁的碳化物与硼化物，包括α-Cr<sub>7</sub>C<sub>3</sub>、β-(Cr, Fe)<sub>7</sub>C<sub>3</sub>、δ-Cr<sub>23</sub>C<sub>7</sub>、θ-Ni<sub>3</sub>B、ψ-CrB、μ-Cr<sub>2</sub>B和γ-Ni，这些相有助于提高硬度。研究结果表明，通过采用优化的PTAW参数，工业界可提高零部件寿命，并降低与原材料、返工及表面缺陷相关的成本。

title: Effect of Barrel Filling Ratio on the Microstructure, Phase Composition and Tribological Performance of Detonation-Sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr Coatings
authors: Zhuldyz Sagdoldina, Aiym Nabioldina, Daryn Baizhan, Nurbol Berdimuratov, Gulsym Bektasova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of barrel filling ratio on the microstructure, phase composition, and tribological performance of detonation-sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings. Coatings were deposited at barrel filling ratios of 43% and 53% under identical spraying conditions. Microstructural characterization revealed the formation of dense lamellar coatings with low porosity and uniform distribution of Cr3C2 carbide particles within the NiCr metallic matrix. Compared with the coating deposited at a barrel filling ratio of 43%, the coating deposited at 53% exhibited a denser microstructure. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed that Cr3C2 and NiCr remained the dominant phases after spraying, while a minor amount of Cr7C3 formed due to partial decarburization of chromium carbide during thermal exposure. Tribological performance was evaluated under dry sliding conditions using a ball-on-disc configuration at normal loads of 10 and 15 N and sliding speeds of 5 and 10 cm/s. Wear volume was determined from the geometry of the wear track after testing, and wear rate was calculated accordingly. The coating produced at a barrel filling ratio of 53% demonstrated improved wear resistance under elevated loads despite exhibiting a higher coefficient of friction. The minimum wear rate reached 1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N), which was associated with reduced porosity and enhanced structural integrity of the coating. The obtained results demonstrate that optimization of detonation spraying parameters significantly affects coating structure and tribological behavior. The developed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings are promising protective materials for components operating under severe friction and wear conditions, including industrial and high-temperature engineering applications.

zh-Hans.title: 桶装填率对爆炸喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层微观组织、相组成和摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了桶装填率对爆炸喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层微观组织、相组成和摩擦学性能的影响。在相同喷涂条件下，分别在43%和53%的桶装填率下制备涂层。微观组织表征结果显示，涂层形成了致密的层状结构，孔隙率较低，Cr3C2碳化物颗粒在NiCr金属基体中分布均匀。与43%桶装填率下沉积的涂层相比，53%桶装填率下沉积的涂层微观组织更致密。X射线衍射分析证实，喷涂后Cr3C2和NiCr仍为主导相，而由于热暴露过程中铬碳化物发生部分脱碳，形成了少量Cr7C3。采用球-盘构型在干滑动条件下评估摩擦学性能，法向载荷分别为10和15 N，滑动速度分别为5和10 cm/s。磨损体积通过测试后磨痕几何形貌确定，并据此计算磨损率。53%桶装填率制备的涂层在较高载荷下表现出更好的耐磨性，尽管其摩擦系数略高。最小磨损率达到1.23 × 10−4 mm3/(m·N)，这与涂层孔隙率降低和结构完整性增强有关。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数会显著影响涂层结构和摩擦学行为。所制备的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层有望作为在严苛摩擦磨损条件下工作的部件的防护材料，包括工业和高温工程应用。

title: Advances in Rare‐Earth Silicate Environmental Barrier Coatings
authors: Zeyu Chen, Yiling Huang, Peng Fan, Yue Sun, Wei Zheng, Xuemei Song
abstract: ABSTRACT Rare‐earth silicates (RE 2 Si 2 O 7 and RE 2 SiO 5 ) are leading candidates for third‐generation environmental barrier coatings (EBCs) because they combine corrosion resistance to molten calcium–magnesium–aluminosilicate (CMAS) and high‐temperature water vapor with thermal expansion coefficients (CTEs) compatible with ceramic matrix composites (CMCs), high melting points, phase stability, and low thermal conductivity. Their composition–structure–property relationships nevertheless impose coupled constraints: a composition that stabilizes a desirable phase or lowers thermal conductivity does not necessarily maximize water‐vapor and CMAS resistance, and plasma‐sprayed coatings can differ substantially from dense bulk ceramics because of SiO 2 loss, amorphous phases, porosity, and segregation. Therefore, this review: (i) clarifies phase‐formation rules and their thermodynamic/crystallographic basis, (ii) compares single‐component and multicomponent silicates while distinguishing bulk and coating evidence, and (iii) summarizes environment‐dependent corrosion mechanisms and multi‐objective design strategies.
venue: Journal of the American Ceramic Society

zh-Hans.title: 稀土硅酸盐环境障涂层的进展
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 稀土硅酸盐（RE 2 Si 2 O 7 和 RE 2 SiO 5）因兼具对熔融钙–镁–铝硅酸盐（CMAS）和高温水蒸气的耐腐蚀性，以及与陶瓷基复合材料（CMCs）相容的热膨胀系数（CTEs）、高熔点、相稳定性和低热导率，而成为第三代环境障涂层（EBCs）的领先候选材料。然而，其成分–结构–性能关系也带来了耦合约束：能够稳定有利相或降低热导率的组成，并不一定能使水蒸气和CMAS耐受性达到最大；且由于SiO 2 损失、非晶相、孔隙和偏析，等离子喷涂涂层可能与致密块体陶瓷存在显著差异。因此，本综述：(i) 阐明相形成规律及其热力学/晶体学基础，(ii) 比较单组分和多组分硅酸盐，同时区分块体与涂层证据，(iii) 总结环境相关腐蚀机制和多目标设计策略。

title: Optimising Cold Spray Additive Manufacturing: Pressure-driven enhancement of mechanical performance in copper deposits
authors: Steven Camilleri, Thi Thuy Tien Tran, Keita Nomoto, Andrew Duguid, Matthew Harbidge, Riyan Rashid
abstract: Cold spray additive manufacturing (CSAM) is a solid-state process capable of producing dense metallic components without melting, making it highly attractive for copper applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical integrity. In this study, the influence of spray pressure at 30 bar, 40 bar, 50 bar and 60 bar on particle velocity, microstructure, and properties of cold-sprayed copper was systematically investigated using a LightSPEE3D system. The cold spray deposits were characterised by X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing, eddy current conductivity, tensile evaluation, and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results reveal that increasing spray pressure enhances particle velocities beyond the critical threshold for copper, leading to improved inter-particle bonding and microstructural refinement consistent with severe plastic deformation and possible continuous dynamic recrystallisation (cDRX)-assisted mechanisms. XRD analysis suggested progressive crystallite refinement and increased dislocation density with pressure, which directly correlated with improved ductility. While hardness decreased due to recovery and recrystallisation, electrical conductivity increased, likely due to improved inter-particle continuity and reduced interfacial discontinuities. Tensile testing showed a clear strength-ductility transition, with deposits at higher pressures exhibiting substantially improved ductility approaching bulk copper behaviour and fully ductile fracture morphologies. Overall, the findings identify an optimum processing window at higher spray pressures, where copper cold spray deposits achieve a balanced combination of conductivity, ductility, and strength. This study highlights the critical role of spray pressure in controlling the interplay between particle velocity, dynamic recrystallisation, and multifunctional performance in CSAM copper components. This study establishes a process-structure-property relationship linking particle velocity, XRD-derived microstructural evolution, conductivity, and tensile behaviour within a LightSPEE3D CSAM system.

zh-Hans.title: 冷喷涂增材制造优化：压力驱动铜沉积层力学性能提升
zh-Hans.abstract: 冷喷涂增材制造（CSAM）是一种能够在不发生熔化的情况下制备致密金属构件的固态工艺，因此对于同时要求电导率和力学完整性的铜应用具有很强吸引力。本研究系统考察了在 30 bar、40 bar、50 bar 和 60 bar 喷涂压力下，采用 LightSPEE3D 系统制备的冷喷铜中颗粒速度、微观组织和性能的影响。通过 X 射线衍射（XRD）、硬度测试、涡流电导率测试、拉伸评价以及扫描电子显微镜（SEM）对冷喷沉积层进行了表征。结果表明，提高喷涂压力可使颗粒速度超过铜的临界阈值，从而增强颗粒间结合并细化微观组织，这与严重塑性变形以及可能由连续动态再结晶（cDRX）辅助的机制一致。XRD 分析表明，随压力升高，晶粒尺寸逐步细化、位错密度增加，这与延展性改善直接相关。尽管由于回复和再结晶导致硬度下降，但电导率提高，可能归因于颗粒间连续性改善以及界面不连续性减少。拉伸测试显示出明显的强度-延展性转变，高压力下的沉积层表现出显著改善的延展性，接近块体铜行为，并呈现完全延性断裂形貌。总体而言，研究结果确定了较高喷涂压力下的最佳工艺窗口，在该窗口内铜冷喷沉积层能够实现导电性、延展性和强度的平衡组合。本研究强调了喷涂压力在控制颗粒速度、动态再结晶以及 CSAM 铜构件多功能性能之间相互作用中的关键作用。本研究建立了一个工艺-组织-性能关系，将 LightSPEE3D CSAM 系统中的颗粒速度、基于 XRD 的微观组织演化、导电性和拉伸行为联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 将冷喷压力从 30 bar 提高到 60 bar 会使铜颗粒速度超过结合阈值，通过更强的颗粒间结合和再结晶形成更致密的沉积层，并改善导电性和延展性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于 CSAM 铜部件，喷涂压力是一个关键调节参数，可在不熔化原料的情况下平衡电性能、拉伸延展性和强度。
method: 在 30、40、50 和 60 bar 下使用 LightSPEE3D 对铜进行冷喷
通过 XRD、SEM、硬度、涡流电导率和拉伸测试进行表征
关联颗粒速度与微观组织演化及力学/电学性能
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了随压力变化的颗粒速度提升、XRD 晶粒细化、电导率增加，以及在较高压力下拉伸和断裂行为向更延性的方向转变。
infographic.watch_item: 更高压力提高了性能，但也降低了硬度，因此如果表面耐磨性重要，工艺调节必须避免过度退火/回复效应。

title: Unraveling the potential of Fe-6.5Si Cold Spray laminates
authors: Hrishikesh Das, Julian D. Escobar Atehortua, Aditya Nittala, Shivakant Shukla, Tingkun Liu, Tej Bahadur Poudel Chhetri
abstract: Abstract This study explores the development of cold-spray-deposited Fe-6.5 wt.%Si for soft magnetic material applications. We present experimental evidence for the successful deposition of Fe-6.5 wt.%Si powder via cold spray, emphasizing the role of carrier gas in optimizing deposition performance for high-temperature materials. Detailed scanning electron microscopy, energy dispersive spectroscopy, and electron back-scattered diffraction analysis reveal the impact of annealing on enhancing magnetic performance through grain growth and stored-strain relaxation. Additionally, the fabrication and analysis of a dual-layer gradient composition, consisting of Fe-3.5 wt.%Si and Fe-6.5 wt.%Si, is successfully demonstrated and characterized using scanning electron-based microscopy. These findings provide insights into leveraging cold spray technology as an additive manufacturing approach for developing magnetic laminates.

infographic.key_insight: Cold spray can successfully build Fe-6.5 wt.%Si laminates for soft magnetic applications, and annealing improves their magnetic potential by relieving strain and promoting grain growth.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work shows cold spray as a viable additive-manufacturing route for high-Si ferromagnetic laminates, including graded Fe-3.5Si/Fe-6.5Si structures.
method: Cold-spray deposition of Fe-6.5 wt.%Si powder using optimized carrier gas conditions
Microstructural characterization by SEM, EDS, and EBSD
Annealing followed by analysis of a dual-layer gradient Fe-3.5Si/Fe-6.5Si laminate
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful deposition and characterization, with microscopy and EBSD/EDS showing microstructural changes after annealing linked to improved magnetic performance.
infographic.watch_item: The results are based on a specific powder system and processing window, so deposition quality and magnetic gains may be sensitive to gas selection, annealing, and layer design.
infographic.paper_title: Unraveling the potential of Fe-6.5Si Cold Spray laminates

zh-Hans.title: Fe-6.5Si 冷喷涂叠层潜力解析
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究探讨了通过冷喷涂沉积 Fe-6.5 wt.%Si 在软磁材料应用中的开发。我们提供了通过冷喷涂成功沉积 Fe-6.5 wt.%Si 粉末的实验依据，强调载气在优化高温材料沉积性能中的作用。详细的扫描电子显微镜、能量色散光谱和电子背散射衍射分析表明，退火通过晶粒长大和残余应变松弛提升磁性能。除此之外，还成功制备并表征了一种由 Fe-3.5 wt.%Si 和 Fe-6.5 wt.%Si 组成的双层梯度成分结构，并使用基于扫描电子的显微技术进行了分析。这些发现为将冷喷涂技术作为一种增材制造方法用于开发磁性叠层提供了见解。

infographic.key_insight: 冷喷涂可成功构建用于软磁应用的 Fe-6.5 wt.%Si 叠层，而退火通过消除应变和促进晶粒长大提升了其磁潜力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究表明，冷喷涂是一种可行的高硅铁磁叠层增材制造路径，包括梯度 Fe-3.5Si/Fe-6.5Si 结构。
method: 采用优化的载气条件对 Fe-6.5 wt.%Si 粉末进行冷喷涂沉积
通过 SEM、EDS 和 EBSD 进行微观组织表征
退火后对双层梯度 Fe-3.5Si/Fe-6.5Si 叠层进行分析
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报道了成功的沉积与表征，且显微镜以及 EBSD/EDS 显示退火后微观结构发生变化，并与磁性能提升相关。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结果基于特定的粉末体系和工艺窗口，因此沉积质量和磁性能增益可能对气体选择、退火条件和层设计较为敏感。

title: EFFECT OF ARGON FLOW RATE DURING AIR PLASMA SPRAYING ON THE STRUCTURE AND PROPERTIES OF NICRFEBSIC COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Nurkhat Bimakhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov
abstract: In this work, self-fluxing metal-ceramic coatings based on the NiCrFeBSiC system were obtained by air plasma spraying, and their structural, mechanical, and tribological properties were investigated.. The effect of argon flow rate (1600 and 1800 L/h) during coating formation was consideredIt was found that an increase in argon flow rate leads to an approximately twofold increase in coating thickness and a twofold decrease in porosity. According to the microhardness measurement results, the microhardness was 1015.8 ± 81.5 HV, while the elastic modulus was 203.9 ± 5.4 GPa. Tribological tests were carried out using the ball-on-disk configurationAt an argon flow rate of 1800 L/h, the friction coefficient showed a lower value (≈0.107), indicating improved wear resistance of the coatings. Scratch test results showed a high level of adhesion between the coatings and the substrate. Although the critical load values (Lc) were similar for both regimes, the coatings obtained at 1800 L/h exhibited a more gradual and stable failure behavior.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Raising argon flow from 1600 to 1800 L/h during air plasma spraying of NiCrFeBSiC coatings produces thicker, denser coatings with better tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This points to argon flow as a practical process-control lever for improving wear resistance and coating quality in thermal spray applications.
method: Air plasma sprayed self-fluxing NiCrFeBSiC metal-ceramic coatings at two argon flow rates: 1600 and 1800 L/h.
Characterized coating structure and mechanical properties using porosity/thickness analysis, microhardness, elastic modulus, and scratch testing.
Evaluated friction and wear behavior with ball-on-disk tribological tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 1800 L/h, coating thickness roughly doubled, porosity decreased by about twofold, and the friction coefficient dropped to approximately 0.107, with similar critical scratch loads but smoother failure progression.
infographic.watch_item: The study compares only two argon flow settings, so broader process optimization and long-term service performance still need validation.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF ARGON FLOW RATE DURING AIR PLASMA SPRAYING ON THE STRUCTURE AND PROPERTIES OF NICRFEBSIC COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 空气等离子喷涂过程中氩气流量对NiCrFeBSiC涂层结构和性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本工作采用空气等离子喷涂制备了基于NiCrFeBSiC体系的自熔性金属-陶瓷涂层，并研究了其结构、力学和摩擦学性能。考察了涂层形成过程中氩气流量（1600和1800 L/h）的影响。结果表明，氩气流量增加会使涂层厚度约增加一倍，同时孔隙率降低一半。根据显微硬度测试结果，显微硬度为1015.8 ± 81.5 HV，而弹性模量为203.9 ± 5.4 GPa。摩擦学测试采用球-盘配置进行。在1800 L/h的氩气流量下，摩擦系数较低（≈0.107），表明涂层耐磨性得到提高。划痕测试结果表明涂层与基体之间具有较高的结合强度。尽管两种工况下的临界载荷值（Lc）相近，但在1800 L/h下获得的涂层表现出更为渐进且稳定的失效行为。

infographic.key_insight: 在空气等离子喷涂NiCrFeBSiC涂层过程中，将氩气流量从1600提高到1800 L/h，可制备出更厚、更致密且摩擦学性能更好的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这表明氩气流量是热喷涂应用中改善耐磨性和涂层质量的一个实用工艺控制参数。
method: 在两种氩气流量条件下（1600和1800 L/h）采用空气等离子喷涂制备自熔性NiCrFeBSiC金属-陶瓷涂层。
通过孔隙率/厚度分析、显微硬度、弹性模量和划痕测试表征涂层结构和力学性能。
采用球-盘摩擦学测试评估摩擦和磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在1800 L/h条件下，涂层厚度约增加一倍，孔隙率约降低一半，摩擦系数降至约0.107；尽管临界划痕载荷相近，但失效过程更平缓。
infographic.watch_item: 该研究仅比较了两种氩气流量设定，因此更广泛的工艺优化和长期服役性能仍需验证。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning produced the most accurate predictions for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, while the multitask neural network showed strong shared-learning generalization across the related welding targets.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps welding engineers choose between a shared multi-output model for efficient learning and an ensemble approach for higher task-specific predictive accuracy in process optimization and quality control.
method: Compared multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding responses: UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated both approaches using RMSE and R² on the same dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved lower RMSE and higher R² for all three outputs, including UTS (RMSE 0.0263, R² 0.9863), weld hardness (0.0467, 0.9782), and HAZ hardness (0.1109, 0.8453).
infographic.watch_item: Results are dataset-dependent, so stacking may generalize less reliably than MTL if future welding conditions differ or the available training data become sparse.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 焊接应用中用于预测 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计为同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与针对每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL 在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于同一数据集，比较了两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是多任务学习（MTL）模型的一种特定类型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在 MTNN 中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用 RMSE 和 R<sup>2</sup> 进行评估，以确定其预测准确性和整体有效性。结果表明，该方法具有较强的预测能力，其 RMSE 分别为 UTS 的 0.1288、焊缝硬度的 0.0886 和 HAZ 硬度的 0.1125，而 R<sup>2</sup> 值分别为 0.6724、0.9215 和 0.8407。这表明其在相互关联的任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的准确性方面优于 MTL：UTS 的 RMSE 为 0.0263、R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.9863；焊缝硬度的 RMSE 为 0.0467、R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.9782；HAZ 硬度的 RMSE 为 0.1109、R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.8453。此类结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了这两种方法之间的权衡。MTL 适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，可实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成则更适合需要高精度、独立预测的情况。两种方法都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前期基础，以结合两种方法的最佳特征。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习对 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度给出了最准确的预测，而多任务神经网络则在相关焊接目标之间表现出较强的共享学习泛化能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于焊接工程师在工艺优化和质量控制中，选择用于高效学习的共享多输出模型，或用于更高任务特定预测精度的集成方法。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层并具有任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
预测三项焊接响应：UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度。
使用 RMSE 和 R² 在同一数据集上评估两种方法。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠方法在全部三个输出上均取得了更低的 RMSE 和更高的 R²，包括 UTS（RMSE 0.0263，R² 0.9863）、焊缝硬度（0.0467，0.9782）以及 HAZ 硬度（0.1109，0.8453）。
infographic.watch_item: 结果依赖于数据集，因此如果未来焊接条件不同或可用训练数据变得稀疏，堆叠方法的泛化可靠性可能不如 MTL。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings can achieve dense, fine-lamellar microstructures that improve corrosion resistance and humidity-dependent wear performance when droplet spreading is optimized.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work guides coating-process tuning for steel protection in corrosive or humid service by linking spray parameters, porosity, and tribological durability.
method: Prepared Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under varied parameters.
Compared coating droplet morphology, microstructure density, corrosion behavior, and wear response.
Evaluated tribological performance in different humidity environments using Si3N4 balls.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that coatings with disk-like droplets, higher circularity and expansion factor, and lower porosity showed better long-term corrosion resistance, while friction coefficient and wear rate decreased as humidity increased.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends strongly on porosity and spray condition control, so inconsistent detonation-spray settings could reduce durability and reproducibility.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上通过不同喷涂参数成功制备了Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成具有致密微观结构的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中较高的孔隙缺陷发生率与较低的长期耐腐蚀性相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件的增加，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 经优化液滴铺展后，爆炸喷涂Fe基非晶涂层可形成致密、细层片微观结构，从而提高耐腐蚀性和随湿度变化的耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本工作通过将喷涂参数、孔隙率和摩擦学耐久性联系起来，为钢材在腐蚀性或潮湿服役环境中的涂层工艺调控提供指导。
method: 在Q235碳钢上采用爆炸喷涂并通过不同参数制备Fe基非晶涂层。
比较涂层液滴形貌、微观结构致密性、腐蚀行为和磨损响应。
使用Si3N4球在不同湿度环境下评估摩擦学性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告表明，具有盘状液滴、更高圆度和铺展因子以及更低孔隙率的涂层表现出更好的长期耐腐蚀性，而摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度增加而降低。
infographic.watch_item: 性能强烈依赖于孔隙率和喷涂条件控制，因此不一致的爆炸喷涂设置可能降低耐久性和重复性。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔凸台几何形状与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊中的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 对轻量化、高强度材料在航空航天和汽车工业中的需求不断增长，使得AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在这类合金中实现可靠连接仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）中的工艺参数。研究引入了一种受传统榫卯接头启发的新型钻孔凸台几何形状，以增强机械互锁并改善焊缝完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计实验，评估抗拉强度和扭转强度。实验在一台定制发动机车床上进行，并将摩擦压力、锻造压力、主轴转速、搭接面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。与此同时，实施了包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa锻造压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔凸台几何形状以及4 min摩擦时间的最佳参数组合表现出卓越的机械性能，获得了538 MPa的抗拉强度和325 MPa的扭转强度。与传统平面-平面接头相比，钻孔凸台结构显示出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高的预测精度，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。
